meta.name: dag-library
meta.description: Store a dag definition once and re-run it in one or two lines, instead of pasting the full definition JSON into every eval cell. MUST USE whenever the user wants to save a DAG for reuse, run a previously saved/named DAG, schedule the same graph repeatedly (nightly/weekly audits, recurring multi-agent pipelines), or asks where to put a dag definition file. Triggers: dag library, save this dag, reuse a dag, run the saved dag, stored dag definition, recurring dag, nightly dag, dag 정의 저장, 저장된 dag 실행, dag 반복 실행, DAG 만들어두고 여러 번.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 保存常用流程一次，以后按名一键重跑。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果手头有反复要跑的流程，想存一次就能复用。
copy.tagline_en: Save a workflow once, then rerun it anytime by name.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have workflows you run repeatedly and want to store them once.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能把工作流(DAG)定义存成文件;以后你说出名字,它就从库里找出并启动。每次重跑会自动加新时间戳,避免覆盖,也可指定后缀复用旧结果。
howto.when: 当你想保存一个 DAG 留待以后重复使用、运行以前存下/命名的 DAG、把同一张图按每晚/每周等固定计划反复跑,或问 dag 定义文件该放哪时,会用到这个技能。

say.text: 保存当前这个 DAG,命名为 nightly-audit。
say.note: 会把定义写入库目录并试跑一次。

say.text: 运行一下库里保存的 nightly-audit。
say.note: 默认会启动一个带时间戳的新 run。

say.text: 跑 nightly-audit 时带上后缀 20260818。
say.note: 同后缀会复用已有结果,失败可在 run 上重试。

howto.what_en: Claude can save a workflow (DAG) definition as a file, then look it up and start it when you give the name. Each rerun gets a fresh UTC timestamp by default so older results aren't overwritten; an optional suffix keeps a run reusable.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to keep a DAG for reuse later, run a previously saved/named DAG, repeat the same graph on a nightly/weekly schedule, or ask where dag definition files should live.

say_en.text: Save the current DAG as nightly-audit.
say_en.note: Writes it into the library and runs it once.
Fresh timestamped run starts by default.
Same suffix reuses prior result; failures can be retried.
